dedupe_keys.name: the quantity and the percentage of fresh water consumption by sector

description: The Quantity and The Percentage of Fresh Water Consumption by Sector is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains The Quantity and The Percentage Of Fresh Water Consumption By Sector (municipal, industrial and agricultural) in Saudi Arabia from 2010-2018. Data from General Authority for Statistics. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Water & Agriculture. Its keywords are Water Consumption. The portal shows 2020-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
